name: Prompted OCR — PDF
takes: One or more PDFs, dropped into the PDF tab
prompt_note: Used, but only for one short question — a field list breaks it
gives: Text per page, and the annotated image of the last page
speed: ~40–60s a page, one page at a time
note: No batching, so slow on long documents. Picks up handwritten notes and stamps; check any table it returns against the page.
